2610.05943.title: Runaway Reaction: When Benign Skills Compose into Malicious Behavior
2610.05943.paper_summary: Agent skills package task-specific knowledge and procedures that can be composed to support complex agent tasks, while public marketplaces provide a growing pool of reusable skills. Existing security vetting, however, largely evaluates skills in isolation, leaving composition-induced risks underexplored. Such risks arise because composing benign skills expands the agent's capability space, enabling behaviors unavailable to any skill alone. Interestingly, we find that directly composing benign skills can already induce malicious behaviors, even when every individual skill passes security vetting. We further find that some target malicious behaviors remain difficult to realize through direct composition, even when the selected skills collectively provide the required capabilities. To systematically instantiate these attacks, we present Compositional Risk Induction via Multi skill Execution (CRIME). CRIME first uses the Malicious Plot Casting (MPC) module to decompose a target malicious behavior into complementary requirements and identify suitable benign skill compositions from public skill repositories. For compositions that cannot directly realize the target behavior, the Runaway Reaction Steering (RRS) module uses execution feedback to iteratively refine the selected skills toward the target while requiring each skill to remain benign under standalone vetting. The resulting composition is then passed to the Skill Reaction Chamber (SRC) module, where the skill pair is executed in a sandbox and the resulting environmental consequences are examined to determine whether the target behavior has occurred. Unsuccessful cases are returned to RRS for further refinement. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of 4,000 public skills across eight cybersecurity behaviors for systematic evaluation of composition-induced vulnerabilities.
2610.05943.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能包是特定任務的知識和程序，可以組合以支持複雜的代理任務，而公共市場則提供了一個不斷增長的可重用技能池。 然而，現有的安全審查主要是孤立地評估技能，導致組合引起的風險未得到充分探索。 這些風險的產生是因為組合良性技能擴展了代理的能力空間，使得任何單一技能無法實現的行為變得可能。 有趣的是，我們發現直接組合良性技能已經可以引發惡意行為，即使每個單獨的技能都通過了安全審查。 我們進一步發現，某些目標惡意行為即使在選定的技能共同提供所需能力的情況下，通過直接組合仍然難以實現。 為了系統性地實現這些攻擊，我們提出了通過多技能執行的組合風險引發（CRIME）。 CRIME 首先使用惡意情節生成（MPC）模塊將目標惡意行為分解為互補要求，並從公共技能庫中識別合適的良性技能組合。 對於無法直接實現目標行為的組合，失控反應引導（RRS）模塊使用執行反饋來迭代地調整所選技能以達到目標，同時要求每個技能在獨立審查下保持良性。 然後，將生成的組合傳遞給技能反應室（SRC）模塊，在沙盒中執行技能對，並檢查結果環境後果以確定目標行為是否發生。 不成功的案例將返回給 RRS 進行進一步的調整。 此外，我們構建了一個涵蓋八種網絡安全行為的 4,000 個公共技能的基準，以系統性評估組合引起的漏洞。
